title: A!MS sets summer ablaze with new single "Need Somebody"
htmlContent: A!MS is finally here, and he brought the flames with his latest single "Need Somebody." Joining forces with UK rap sensation ArrDee, A!MS offers a sun-soaked track that is culturally rich. Entitled "Need Somebody," the track is out now and is an audacious prelude to his upcoming album' Peak Season'. In "Need Somebody" there's also a magnetic lure to its Afrobeats-spiked rhythm that's perfect for poolside playlists. What makes it pop is A! MS' brand new 'Global Street' genre, a raw blend of street-influenced storytelling with an international polish. The song offers an opportunity for some much-needed escape. It's about catching the light when the world feels heavy, a universally resonant theme. A!MS glides over the production with a laidback but knowing nonchalance, and ArrDee supplies his unmistakable bounce and charm, injecting the track with a UK rap spin that sits perfectly on the Afrobeats flow. The production, courtesy of Colombia's Golden Boy with some lyric writing help from Stige, builds a lively, percussion-forward base that acts as the glue that binds the whole thing. It's clean, catchy, and textured with enough sonic detail to bring you back for another listen. https://open.spotify.com/track/5J3FDYnkuLhPdQD8Obe6vO What "Need Somebody" genuinely affirms is the old A!MS is building a sound here. With "Peak Season" coming, this track feels like an invitation to dance, to vibe, and to take part in a worldwide party where street-rooted authenticity and cross-cultural unity are the global currency of cool. Whether you're here for the hooks, the grooves, or the message of elevation, "Need Somebody" delivers. This is A!MS making a statement, and if this track is any indication, 'Peak Season' is a peak in his development as an artist and as a genre-pusher.
excerpt: A!MS sets summer ablaze with “Need Somebody,” a powerful new single that combines infectious rhythm with raw emotion, showcasing his dynamic artistry.
